name: Microgrid reactive-control authority transfer
aliases: microgrids Microgrid voltage and reactive-power controls
summary: Coordinates a documented change in ownership of the voltage-support objective.
description: Coordinates a documented change in ownership of the voltage-support objective. Voltage and reactive-power control coordinate the AC operating condition of the microgrid resources. A voltage target, reactive-power target and power-factor target represent different control objectives and should have explicit ownership.

In an islanded microgrid, the assigned reference source supports bus voltage while other compatible resources share reactive demand according to the selected control method. Grid-connected operation can use a different objective at the PCC. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Old and new controller availability” at the input and “Selected reactive-control authority” at the output. A smooth transfer requires a validated control strategy.
